title: Sexual Assault Survivor Protection Act Orders
citation: Sexual Assault Survivor Protection Act of 2015, N.J.S.A. 2C:14-13 et seq.
key_points: For victims of nonconsensual sexual contact, sexual penetration, lewdness, or an attempt at any of these, who do not qualify for a DV restraining order (no DV relationship).
The victim may apply for a temporary protective order without the respondent present, followed by a final hearing.
Relief includes no contact, staying away from the victim's home, work, school and other places, and other protections.
No criminal complaint is required to apply.
officer_notes: Help the victim apply the same way you would for a TRO, following your court's after-hours procedure.
